caption: Figure 7: Synchronous and asynchronous data parallel training
description:
Description: The figure illustrates two types of data parallelism in distributed machine learning: synchronous and asynchronous. In the synchronous model, a single client updates the model parameters, which are then distributed to all devices simultaneously. In the asynchronous model, multiple clients update the model parameters independently and at different times, which are then aggregated.
